title: Jazz Jam & Potluck @ The Monarch
event_description: Weekly jazz jam session welcoming musicians of all levels and ages. This celebration of jazz invites players to share the stage collaborate and showcase their talents.
backline: Piano bass drums and small vocal PA provided
event_venue_information:
The Monarch Music and Arts Community

The Monarch is a nonprofit creative hub social club and resource center that's home to a community of artists musicians and music lovers. The intimate venue features a front room that holds approximately 50 people and an upper back room with space for another 20 creating a homey welcoming environment perfect for acoustic performances.

Live Music Programming

The Monarch hosts a diverse array of touring singer-songwriters Americana artists and local musicians. The venue has earned praise for its great sound perfect lighting and gracious team of community builders who create an engaged atmosphere for performers.

Jazz Jam Sessions

The bi-weekly jazz jam hosted by the JonAnthony Quintet takes place on the 2nd and 4th Sundays from 3-6 PM. The session is free with no cover charge though donations to support host musicians are encouraged. Musicians should bring their instruments (guitarists need small amps vocalists need their own microphones) as the venue provides piano bass drums and vocal PA.

title: Open Bluegrass Jam @ Goodwood Brewing
event_description: Weekly bluegrass jam session hosted by 502 Stringband. All skill levels welcome to bring instruments and play along or simply enjoy local community bluegrass talents.
event_venue_information:
Goodwood Brewing Company

Located in historic downtown Louisville Goodwood Brewing is one of Kentucky's longest continuously operated breweries having started operations in 1990. The brewery specializes in barrel-aged beers bourbon barrel finishing and craft spirits honoring Kentucky's distilling legacy.

Taproom & Food

The taproom features 12 Goodwood-brewed beers on tap plus wine and local spirits. The kitchen serves southern-inspired cuisine including Chicken and Waffles Fried Green Tomatoes and brisket-topped burgers. Music Bingo happens Tuesdays with Trivia on Thursdays.

Bluegrass Jam

Every Saturday afternoon the taproom hosts an open bluegrass jam from 3-6 PM. The session has been running for years bringing together fiddle banjo guitar mandolin and bass players for traditional bluegrass picking. No cover charge just bring your instrument and join the circle or sit back with a craft beer and listen.

title: Comedy Open Mic @ Louisville Comedy Club
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring professional comedians working new material and first-timers taking the stage. Scheduled month-to-month with online sign-ups required by the 15th of each month.
event_venue_information:
Louisville Comedy Club

Premier stand-up comedy venue in Louisville featuring national touring acts and weekly open mic nights. The club operates with a professional atmosphere showcasing everything from polished headliners to comics getting on stage for the first time.

Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday night features open mic starting at 7 PM. The show is completely free with happy hour specials all night. Comics sign up online through a monthly scheduling system - forms must be submitted by the 15th of each month with lineups posted by month end. Performers who are not selected can arrive between 6-7 PM to enter a drawing for 3 additional spots with up to 4 minutes of stage time.

Professional Shows

The club hosts ticketed comedy shows featuring regional and national touring comedians throughout the week providing opportunities for local comics to open for established acts.
